pages.name: rso-recognition-process
pages.title: Recognition Process - Campus Activities
lines: Recognition Process
The Spring 2027 RSO Recognition process is now open on EngageSC for new RSOs and RSOs re-establishing after a lapse in recognition.
If you need accessibility accommodations or have questions related to RSO recognition, please contact Campus Activities.
Important Dates
Deadlines +
October 27: Application opens
November 22 at 11:59pm: Application closes. You must submit the form on EngageSC before 11:59pm.
December 1: Deadline for advisors to submit their requirements.
Info Sessions, Workshops, and Office Hours +
Attend an info session to learn how the recognition process works.
Office hours are held every week in the Campus Activities office.

lines: Recognized Student Organizations
RSO Resources
Resources for recognized student organizations at USC are gathered on this page.
Open a section below to see what it holds and how to use it.
EngageSC +
Review helpful tips on how to use all the features EngageSC has to offer.
Space Requests +
Recognized Student Organizations in good standing can request to book space on campus.
Groups interested in requesting a classroom space should submit the Classroom Scheduling form.
Recognized Student Organizations in good standing can open a USC Credit Union bank account.

lines: Recognized Student Organizations
USC is home to more than a thousand recognized student organizations.
Find an organization that fits you on the EngageSC directory.
Start a new organization through the recognition process each semester.
Meet the Campus Activities staff who advise student organizations.
The recognition application for new organizations closes November 22 at 11:59pm.
